replacement Window load not observed within1500ms

findings: Both native and pinned Chromium invoke the earlier-registered noncapture listener before capture for Window load/pageshow; both callbacks are AT_TARGET. The earlier capture-first hypothesis is not the measured compatibility contract.
Chromium child iframe-element load precedes pageshow, after the load microtask. Native231 currently puts iframe-element load before that microtask and never emits pageshow.

In load-document-open, Chromium records replacement DCL, no replacement Window load, then pageshow in the replacement document. In pageshow-document-open, replacement DCL appears with neither another Window load nor another pageshow. The matrix records an unmet replacement-load wait in each case.
Chromium load-frame-removal records only before-remove; native231 continues after-remove, emits an iframe-element load, and runs the queued load microtask.

Requesting srcdoc navigation leaves the old document active through its pageshow in Chromium, then the replacement receives its own complete lifecycle. A navigation request alone does not establish committed replacement.

Chromium reports a thrown load listener, continues the later listener and lifecycle, and still completes iframe loading when pageshow is canceled. Native231 already reports/continues the listener, but has no pageshow.
DOMContentLoaded composed is false in Chromium but true in231; this existing native metadata gap must be fixed deliberately or kept separate from a narrower scope claim.
